public_rationale: The entire-industry shutdown allegation is contradicted on the ordinary US AI industry reading. Fable and Mythos were disabled, but Anthropic expressly said its other models remained available. This finding does not establish that the action was harmless or resolve the broader claim about arbitrary government and industry prosperity.
limitations: The result depends on reading entire industry as the US AI industry, as the surrounding text suggests.
A narrower claim that the directive shut down Fable and Mythos is supported.
The universal causal generalization remains untested.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: No industry can thrive if the government appears arbitrary and capricious, as it did last night when it (effectively) abruptly shut down an entire thriving industry and appeared very selective and reactive in its choices.
conditions: if the government appears arbitrary and capricious

statement.excerpt: That said, no industry can thrive if the government appears arbitrary and capricious, as they did last night, (effectively) abruptly shutting down an entire thriving industry, and appearing very selective and reactive in the choices it made.
statement.document_title: The White House’s shambolic AI policy

from_speaker: if the government appears arbitrary and capricious
(effectively) abruptly shutting down an entire thriving industry
our_interpretation: Last night identifies the June 12, 2026 directive.
The surrounding reference to the US AI industry supplies the ordinary scope of entire industry.
Effectively shutting down an industry means stopping its ordinary operations across providers, including through indirect effects.
The concrete shutdown allegation can be tested separately from the broader causal generalization. A materially false shutdown allegation contradicts that part of the compound claim.
criteria.support_condition: Operational records show an effective industry-wide shutdown caused by the directive, and credible comparative evidence supports the claimed incompatibility between arbitrary government action and industry prosperity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous records establish that substantial AI operations remained available, refuting the entire-industry shutdown; alternatively, adequately defined comparative evidence refutes the universal causal assertion.
